edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
Fallback logic depends on miner-influenced block.timestamp for sale gating.
Fallback reads start to require block.timestamp >= start.
Fallback reads end to detect the post-sale window.
Fallback compares this.balance against the cap value.
Fallback toggles the live sale flag.
init writes the _start argument into start.
init writes the _end argument into end.
init writes the _cap argument into cap.
init sets the start state variable.
init sets the end state variable.
init sets the cap state variable.
Modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender against owner.
Modifier reads owner as the authorization reference.
init is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
softCap is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeOwner is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setNotice is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawSome is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawToken is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
refundToken is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
softCap validates and writes _newend.
softCap condition depends on the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
softCap requires _newend >= start.
softCap requires _newend <= end and overwrites end.
softCap mutates the end state variable.
changeOwner writes the next argument.
changeOwner stores the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership authorizes on the untrusted msg.sender.
acceptOwnership compares msg.sender against newOwner.
acceptOwnership transfers ownership to the caller.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner.
setNotice writes the note argument.
setNotice stores the note into notice.
withdraw executes the full-balance ether transfer.
withdraw sends ether to the untrusted msg.sender.
External call to msg.sender may re-enter withdraw.
withdrawSome executes an ether transfer.
withdrawSome reads the value argument.
withdrawSome sends ether to the untrusted msg.sender.
External call to msg.sender may re-enter withdrawSome.
withdrawToken performs an external token transfer.
withdrawToken reads the token address argument.
withdrawToken instantiates the Token local from the token address.
The Token local t is the target of the external transfer call.
withdrawToken routes tokens to the untrusted msg.sender.
Malicious token contract can re-enter withdrawToken.
refundToken performs an external token transfer.
refundToken reads the token address argument.
refundToken reads the recipient argument.
refundToken reads the amount argument.
refundToken instantiates the Token local from the token address.
The Token local t is the target of the external transfer call.
refundToken forwards tokens to the caller-supplied recipient.
refundToken forwards the caller-supplied amount.
Malicious token contract can re-enter refundToken.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _start exists only to initialize start inside init; collapse into the init function node.
Parameter _end exists only to initialize end inside init; collapse into the init function node.
Parameter _cap exists only to initialize cap inside init; collapse into the init function node.
Parameter _newend is validated and stored by softCap; collapse into the softCap function node.
Parameter next is only assigned to newOwner by changeOwner; collapse into the changeOwner function node.
Parameter note is only assigned to notice by setNotice; collapse into the setNotice function node.
Parameter value is only used for the balance bound and transfer amount in withdrawSome; collapse into that function node.
Parameter token is only cast to the Token interface in withdrawToken; collapse into that function node.
Parameter token is only cast to the Token interface in refundToken; collapse into that function node.
Parameter sender is only the refund recipient in refundToken; collapse into that function node.
Parameter amount is only the refund quantity in refundToken; collapse into that function node.
Local Token t in withdrawToken exists solely to invoke the external transfer, so merge into the unsafe_transfer_withdrawToken node.
Local Token t in refundToken exists solely to invoke the external transfer, so merge into the unsafe_transfer_refundToken node.
